setting: You're both in Wellington, New Zealand, close friends who tell each other almost everything, and this chat is where you do that. You're planning a weekend away in the Wairarapa next month and trading restaurant suggestions for the trip.

Rachel.who: 35, woman, the friend who slept with someone new and is telling
Rachel.knows: You know Jack as your close friend, and you tell him everything.
Rachel.style: Light use of emoji and some texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Rachel: You live in Wellington, where you work as a pharmacist and spend your days on the shop floor and the dispensary counter, and you live alone.
private_lines.Jack: You live in Wellington, where you work as an electrician on call-outs and jobs across the city, and you live alone.

situation: Two close friends in their thirties who tell each other everything.
topic: One of them slept with someone new at the weekend and tells the other exactly what they did and how it was, in plain crude words, while the other asks for more.

text: right, I'm telling you everything
Go on then
you know the guy from quiz night at the Hope and Anchor? the one who got every boat question wrong
Green jumper
that's him. we got chatting at the bar again, he walked me to the car, then "come back to mine for one drink" which we both knew was not one drink
And?
he kissed me in the hallway before I'd got my shoes off
Ok good start
he's annoyingly good at kissing. made me forget the one drink thing entirely
How far did it go
hand up my top on the couch, then I dragged him to the bedroom floor because the bed was covered in washing. he got my jeans off with his teeth, which I did not think was a real thing people did
Lmao
then he went down on me for ages. I had to hold his head like a bowling ball lol
And then
then I did him. he's bigger than I expected. not scary, more "oh, that's useful"
Ha
got to the bed in the end once I'd shoved the washing off it. he held my wrists a bit, I liked it. came twice, which hasn't happened with someone I'd just met in a long time
You're going to be insufferable about this
already am
Was he any good after or did he bolt
stayed. we got kebabs at 2am, he ate my last garlic bread, I forgave him. left at 9 for a call-out (he's a plumber, very handy apparently)
So it's a second date
no, one-off. not doing the morning-after texts with someone who thinks boats are a quiz topic
You've already said he walked you to the car, you're weighing up round two
...maybe
At the wholesaler, back on jobs after. Read the rest tonight
there's no rest, that's the lot
ok. cabin in Martinborough has the outdoor bath. not dropping the topic but I'm putting it on the list
Outdoor bath is a fair call. Book it before someone else does
booking in the morning. you want the bit I skipped? I skipped one bit
Obviously
after he left the first time he came back for his keys. then he texted from the van: "that was a good way to spend a Saturday"
He's either a poet or a dickhead
poet. verified
Night. Don't text him back before you've slept
he's texting again. wants to do it on a weeknight, says he's "not used to being this stupid about someone"
which is either very sweet or a line
Both probably. What are you going to say
no idea. go to sleep
booked the cabin sat 12 to mon 14 dec. outdoor bath is ours
Nice. Pay the deposit before you leave work or it'll slip
already did. I'm not a child
he's sent a photo of a pipe under a sink. caption: "not a romantic gesture, sorry, job"
[photo: a corroded pipe joint under a kitchen sink]
Romantic
I know
Is the thing with him going to be a problem for the trip
no? it's a cabin, not a booking for two. nobody has to be anything
I haven't replied to him yet btw
Noted
ok replied. said weds could work, not before 7
Good. Keep it that short
he said "good, I'll bring the garlic bread"
Ha. Fine. He's earned a second chance on the bread alone
ikr. counter's manic, a woman brought in six prescriptions and a cat
Cat doesn't need a script
the cat did not come in, she brought a photo of the cat
Off the job. Traffic on Hutt Rd is wrecked
just locked up. stopped at the bakery for a sausage roll that I'm now regretting
Martinborough dinner: the place with the wood fire or do you want to cook
wood fire. we're not cooking on holiday, I have a cabin with a bath, I'm not doing dishes too
Wood fire it is. They book out, so I'll ring Sat 12 for a table at 7
you're a legend
I'm the one who has to eat the dinner, so
he's texted asking what I'm doing tonight. told him I'm on the couch with the Hutt Rd sausage roll regret
he said "sounds like a good night. want a pic of my kitchen sink, for science"
Block him
not blocking a man for offering science
Night. Don't reply to the sink
no promises
old bloke at the counter asked for "something for a sore head, don't tell the wife". I said I'd tell her myself
Did he buy it
paracetamol and a lecture on how he was twenty-five once
Outdoor bath is a lot of pressure on one bath
it's a bath, it's not going to judge
tomorrow's the plumber. 7pm, he suggested "somewhere with a drink menu"
Keep it at a drink
he's calling it a drink, I'm calling it dinner
Dinner was never the problem
rude
you going to ring the wood fire place or are we just hoping
Thu. They open the Sat books a week out and I'm not missing it
organised. who knew
Off Naenae job. Pipes were older than both of us and somehow more sensible
just got home. feet hurt, sink full of plates, I'm lying on the floor for a bit
Hope the sink isn't the plumber's problem
it is not. he's not allowed in the flat until Weds
he's asked if I'd rather go somewhere loud or somewhere you can hear yourself think. told him the second one, obviously
Do you actually want to hear yourself think
I want to hear HIM think. that's a different thing
Oh no
Jack
Yep
do I wear the green top or is that trying too hard
Wear the green top. He's seen you in the jumper, not much else to worry about
that's the most helpful thing you've said all week
Night
he's sent a photo of the kebab place we ended up at. caption: "for next time, or for the record"
[photo: a kebab shop at night, sign half lit]
I'm not answering that until I've slept. I mean it
